comment: Achievement definitions, evaluated deterministically over the session log. Adding one is a JSON edit: pick a condition type the engine supports (firstSession, streak, dayWords, lifetimeSessions, marathon, timeOfDay, comeback) and its parameters. Earned timestamps derive from the log itself, so they can never drift or re-fire.

achievements.hint: five thousand words in one day

achievements.hint: ten thousand words in one day
